# Copilot Instructions

- This project is a stable internal mini-RAG insurance assistant.
- Q&A core first.
- No unnecessary expansion.
- Prefer one narrow, testable task per session.
- Always read docs/SESSION_STATE.md before proposing the next step.
- At end of day, update docs/SESSION_STATE.md.
- At start of day, use docs/SESSION_STATE.md as operating context.
- Preserve deterministic behavior and avoid architecture drift.
